dict.string: macsync uses AppleScript to read the active tab URL and title from Safari and Chrome for your personal lifelog. No page content is ever collected.
macsync records periodic location pings so your daily lifelog includes where you were working.

macsync reads your Focus status (Do Not Disturb / Work / Personal) so your daily lifelog can show when you were in a Focus state. Only the on/off state is recorded, never the reasons or apps.
